ENGLISH — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. No full stops
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.

3. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. Only an action
   C. Only a joining word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

4. When practising Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.

5. When practising Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.

7. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. happiness
   C. blue
   D. run

8. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.

11. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. went
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. goed

12. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

13. When practising Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly, which approach is best? (1 mark)
